name: SectionHead - Kicker, Title, Intro And Action
description: The band head every Atlas section opens with, carrying all four of its parts at once: the crimson eyebrow, the heading, the intro, and the count sitting in the right-hand slot. The counter is what proves the layout rather than decorating it — the head is a space-between row, so a capture with only a title would look like a plain heading and demonstrate nothing. Bounded to the content width the real bands give it.
